budgets.label: Under ₹1,000
budgets.expect: Prices under ₹1,000 are rare for watches worth recommending, so check the strap and warranty first.

budgets.label: Under ₹2,000
budgets.expect: At this level, expect simple quartz (battery) watches. Look at build, strap and case size first, and keep your expectations realistic.

budgets.label: Under ₹3,000
budgets.expect: There is usually more choice in dial finishes and straps. Quartz watches are the norm, so judge the strap and the details.

budgets.label: Under ₹5,000
budgets.expect: Look for better finishing, a more solid strap or bracelet and a clearer dial. Some watches at this level add scratch-resistant glass, so check the listing.

budgets.label: Under ₹6,000
budgets.expect: Around this budget look for a sturdier case, a better strap and a clear warranty.

budgets.label: Under ₹10,000
budgets.expect: You may see more refined finishing and metal bracelets. Compare the glass, the case material and the warranty on each listing.

budgets.label: Under ₹15,000
budgets.expect: At this level compare finishing, glass and the warranty provider, and check the exact model code.

budgets.label: Under ₹20,000
budgets.expect: Compare the movement, case finishing and warranty carefully, and buy from the brand or an authorised seller.

budgets.label: Under ₹40,000
budgets.expect: This is the premium end. Compare materials, movement and warranty, check the case size against your wrist, and buy from the brand or an authorised seller.

budgets.label: Under ₹50,000
budgets.expect: This is the top premium band. Compare materials, movement and warranty, check the case size against your wrist, and buy from the brand or an authorised seller.
